content.title: QuidelOrtho: Q3 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: SAN DIEGO (AP) — QuidelOrtho Corporation (QDEL) on Wednesday reported a loss of $733 million in its third quarter. The San Diego-based company said it had a loss of $10.78 per share. Earnings, adjusted for one-time gains and costs, were 80 cents per share.
